intent: Frame one conversational turn as a speech bubble, painting its content surface and marking which side of the conversation it came from.
typical_uses: One turn of a chat thread, such as a user's question or an assistant's reply
A short quoted reply, suggestion or structured output shown as part of a conversation

dont_use_when.situation: A full conversation row with an avatar, a sender name, a timestamp or row-level actions

instead.target: Message, with the Bubble inside its MessageContent

dont_use_when.situation: A status update, system note or labelled break between turns
A status or error message about the page, not a turn in a conversation
A short inline label, tag or count
A bounded panel around content that is not part of a conversation

mounted_in.container: any parent in the consuming application
mounted_in.note: A single Bubble may stand on its own, outside a BubbleGroup or a Message row.

invariants.text: The bubble's own box has no fill, border or padding; every variant paints only a BubbleContent that is a direct child of the Bubble (bubble.module.css `.bubble.variant* > .bubbleContent`), so a BubbleContent nested one element deeper renders unpainted.

`align="end"` moves the bubble with `align-self: flex-end`, which takes effect only when its parent is a flex column, as BubbleGroup and MessageContent are; inside a plain block parent the bubble stays at the start edge.

The direct BubbleContent's top corner on the `align` side is cut to var(--radius-xs) through a logical corner (`border-start-start-radius` for start, `border-start-end-radius` for end), so it mirrors under a right-to-left direction.
The bubble sizes to its content up to 80% of its parent's width; `variant="ghost"` lifts the cap to 100%, makes the content's border transparent and removes its fill, padding and radius.
An explicit `variant={null}` renders the default variant, in both the class and the `data-variant` attribute.

anti_patterns.dont: Put an avatar, sender name, timestamp or row actions inside Bubble
anti_patterns.do_instead: Place them on the surrounding Message's own parts, and keep only the turn's content in the Bubble

anti_patterns.dont: Let a variant's color be the only signal of an error or a sender
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep the error or the sender in the text or the alignment as well, since a variant is a paint treatment and adds no text or icon of its own

a11y.by: `variant="destructive"` paints --danger text over a 10% --destructive tint; measured with src/__test-utils__/contrast.ts on the light theme it reaches 3.66:1 over --background and 4.00:1 over --card, below the 4.5:1 that its 14px body text needs (the dark theme reaches 4.92:1)

good.title: A reply with a reaction at the end edge
good.code: Done, the stale route is gone. 👍

good.title: Unframed assistant text spanning the row
good.code:
<Bubble variant="ghost">
  <BubbleContent>Here is a summary of the three changes.</BubbleContent>
</Bubble>

bad.title: Text placed straight into Bubble
bad.why: Bubble's own box has no fill, border or padding; the variant paints only a direct BubbleContent, so this text renders bare.

companions.typed_by: cva(...), returns (props: VariantProps<typeof bubbleVariants> & { className?: string }) => string
companions.description: The class-name builder Bubble uses for its own wrapper. It emits the wrapper's base and variant classes only: the paint lands on a direct BubbleContent child, and the speaker-corner notch needs the `data-align` attribute Bubble sets, neither of which the builder supplies.
